# GeneralizedReadoutMap

**Domain**: TCC

## Definition
A formal mapping from the monitored quantum reservoir's measurement outcomes to output weights, generalizing standard linear readouts. Enables flexible integration of quantum measurement statistics into topology-centric computing pipelines for enhanced classification or prediction.
